# Wrap WETH

> Wrap WETH is a non-custodial interface for wrapping native ETH into WETH at a fixed 1:1 rate by calling deposit() on the canonical WETH contract, and for unwrapping it back. It works on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, using each chain's own WETH contract. The user connects their own wallet and signs every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Wrapping calls deposit() on the canonical WETH contract and mints WETH 1:1 for the ETH sent.
- No token approval and no slippage are involved; the only cost is network gas paid in ETH.
- Supported networks: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, each with its own WETH contract.
- WETH is an ERC-20 token needed by DEX pools, limit-order protocols, lending markets and NFT marketplace bids; native ETH is not ERC-20.
- Keep some ETH unwrapped for gas, since WETH cannot pay network fees; unwrapping returns ETH 1:1.
